statement: Let (D, d, k) and a chosen finite generically separable base A ⊆ D be as in Lemma 2.2, and let Λ be the tower (2.1). There is a D-algebra CD, carrying a compatible Λ-action, such that restriction of scalars defines an additive nonnegative length λD = λ∞ on its modules annihilated by a power of d. For every parameter system z1, . . . , zh of D and every integer v ≥ 1, λDHi(zv 1, . . . , zv h; CD) = 0 (i > 0), (2.4) λD CD/(zv 1, . . . , zv h)CD  = vh e((z1, . . . , zh), D). (2.5) The right side is positive and finite. The algebra and length are independent of the parameter system z. For the regular parameters of A, in particular, λD CD/(tv 1, . . . , tv h)CD  = vh rankA D. (2.6) The finite-stage, infimum, and supremum properties of Lemma 2.3 remain available on underlying tower modules; they do not require that the relevant submodules or covers be CD-modules.
